connector.name: UK Police MCP Server from MCPBundles
connector.registryDescription: Access street-level crime reports, stop and search data, and outcomes across UK police forces
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.mcpbundles.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the desktop bundle uk-police.mcpb. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.mcpbundles, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OAuth2 Bearer token or API key. Use 'Bearer <token>' for OAuth or 'Api-Key <key>' for API key authentication.
